Q: How to hide Code in Jupyter Notebook w/ VS Code? A:

You can use .env to hide the code.

hidden_code = (code)

Then use the variable hidden_code inside brackets to use it.

Q: Why am I getting "Error in 1:columns : argument of length 0" with apply.fromstart in PerformanceAnalytics A:

The error is because your qpcr_a100p.z zoo object doesn't have a dim attribute, so it technically doesn't have any columns. Also, apply.fromstart expects a time-based index.

So set dims and convert the index to Date, and the function will work.

dim(qpcr_a100p.z) <- c(NROW(qpcr_a100p.z),NCOL(qpcr_a100p.z))
index(qpcr_a100p.z) <- as.Date(index(qpcr_a100p.z), origin="1970-01-01")
out <- apply.fromstart(qpcr_a100p.z, FUN = "mean", gap = 1)
# convert the index back to numeric, if necessary
index(out) <- as.numeric(index(out))

Q: Is it possible to use the "code" command in SSH'ed terminal to open VS Code on local machine with SSH extension? A:

I found much better & simple answer thanks to this post.

Simply create new script file named code with below contents & put file under any folder from $PATH. (echo $PATH to see what folders you can use)

#!/usr/bin/env zsh

# Script to find and execute VSCode remote CLI with retry logic

local max_retry=10

for i in {1..$max_retry}
do
    # Find the most recent VSCode server folder (directories only, excluding .staging)
    local recent_folder=$(ls -td ~/.vscode-server/cli/servers/*/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.staging/$' | head -n1 | xargs basename)

    if [[ -z ${recent_folder} ]]; then
        echo "VSCode server folder not found"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Construct path to the code script
    local script=~/.vscode-server/cli/servers/${recent_folder}/server/bin/remote-cli/code

    if [[ ! -f ${script} ]]; then
        echo "VSCode remote script not found at: ${script}"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Find VSCode IPC socket files using zsh glob qualifiers
    # (=oc[N]) means: = follow symlinks, oc sort by change time (newest first), [N] use i-th match
    local sockets=(/run/user/$UID/vscode-ipc-*.sock(=ocN))

    if [[ ${#sockets[@]} -lt $i ]]; then
        echo "VSCode IPC socket not found (attempt $i of $max_retry)"
        continue
    fi

    local socket=${sockets[$i]}

    # Try to execute with this socket
    export VSCODE_IPC_HOOK_CLI=${socket}

    if ${script} "$@" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        exit 0
    fi
done

echo "Failed to find valid VS Code window"
exit 1

Bash version

#! /bin/bash
                                                                             
max_retry=10                                                                 
                                                                             
for i in $(seq 1 $max_retry)                                                 
do
    recent_folder=$(ls -d ~/.vscode-server/cli/servers/*/ -t | head -n1 | tail -1)                                                                       
    script=$(echo $recent_folder/server/bin/remote-cli/code)   
    if [[ -z ${script} ]]                                                    
    then                                                                     
        echo "VSCode remote script not found"                                
        exit 1                                                               
    fi                                                                       
    socket=$(ls /run/user/$UID/vscode-ipc-* -t | head -n$i | tail -1)        
    if [[ -z ${socket} ]]                                                    
    then                                                                     
        echo "VSCode IPC socket not found"                                   
        exit 1                                                               
    fi                                                                       
    export VSCODE_IPC_HOOK_CLI=${socket}                                     
    ${script} $@ 2>/dev/null                                                             
    if [ "$?" -eq "0" ]; then                                                
        exit 0                                                               
    fi                                                                       
done                                                                         
                                                                             
echo "Failed to find valid VS Code window"

Update

Above script doesn't work with recent updates. I had to change first line to

local script=$(echo ~/.vscode-server/cli/servers/*/server/bin/remote-cli/code(*oc[$i]N))

Update2

Original script may fail if recently opened ssh window is closed, yet there is another SSHed window open. I have enhanced the script to enable retrying the command with recent N(default 10) windows.

Update3

Above bash script doesn't work with recent updates. I had to change first line to

recent_folder=$(ls -d ~/.vscode-server/cli/servers/*/ -t | head -n1 | tail -1)
